notes.title: 0.3.1 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]What’s New[/h3][list][*][p]Added logging to facilitate easier debugging of issues found by playtesters.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Objects can once again be carried through doorways.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs no longer become super fast after being carried back and forth through doors.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Join the [/i][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F6NuU2ccsA2"]Discord [/url][i]to participate in the playtest and receive more development updates![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/66e3d74e9607e61eeec9c91b_Logo.svg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 0.3.0 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]What’s New[/h3][list][*][p]New NPCs![/p][/*][*][p]A new ability![/p][/*][*][p]Lots of new areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Direction of travel indicator for yanking lasso action while swinging.[/p][/*][*][p]Playtest exit survey.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Input method now switches dynamically between controller and keyboard-mouse, based on which is in use.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated speech bubble layout to make them more readable.[/p][/*][*][p]Color palette updates.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]NPCs can once again be picked up and yeeted around.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Join the [/i][url="https://discord.gg/6NuU2ccsA2"]Discord [/url][i]to participate in the playtest and receive more development updates![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/66e3d74e9607e61eeec9c91b_Logo.svg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 0.2.0 Playtest Patch Notes
notes.notes: [h3]What’s New[/h3][list][*][p]Added Discord link to title screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Give Feedback” button to pause menu to allow users to submit reports via Discord, Google Forms, or the Steam Community.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Updated title screen logo.  [/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Game no longer registers inputs when the window is not in focus.[/p][/*][*][p]Title screen lasso animation is now positioned and scaled correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Join the [/i][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F6NuU2ccsA2"]Discord [/url][i]to participate in the playtest and receive more development updates![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6257adef93867e50d84d30e2/66e3d74e9607e61eeec9c91b_Logo.svg"][/img][/p]
